description: cash.setWhitelistManager(DeliverableFXManager, false) [FREEZES every cash movement on DFXM-managed accounts, including subaccount 14's ~1.368e22 settled cash. CashAsset is shared and unsegregated, so without this any USDC deposited for SRM/market-maker use is withdrawable against that balance by whoever controls 0xc94e23c5. REVERSIBLE: the same call with true re-enables it, which is required before any burn, since updateSettledCash and donateBalance both route through _checkManager.]
